mapper.select: SELECT id, name, topo_type, description, create_time, update_time FROM project ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (name, topo_type, description) VALUES (#{name}, #{topoType}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET name = #{name}, topo_type = #{topoType}, description = #{description}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
